# HouseWatchers

> HouseWatchers is a key-holding and second-home check service operating exclusively within Barcelona city, Spain. The commercial name is HouseWatchers; the website is HouseWatchers.es.

## Main pages
- [Home (Spanish)](https://housewatchers.es/): services, plans, contact and service area.
- [Services](https://housewatchers.es/servicios.html): key access, authorised visitors, technicians and property coordination.
- [Visits](https://housewatchers.es/visitas.html): what a preventive home visit includes.
- [About](https://housewatchers.es/quienes-somos.html): company information.
- [Guides](https://housewatchers.es/blog.html): practical articles for second-home owners.
- [October guide](https://housewatchers.es/blog-preparar-segunda-residencia-otono-barcelona.html): autumn home checklist.

## Languages
- [Español](https://housewatchers.es/)
- [Català](https://housewatchers.es/ca.html)
- [English](https://housewatchers.es/en.html)
- [Français](https://housewatchers.es/fr.html)

## Service information
- Only Barcelona city, not the wider metropolitan area.
- Key holding, property access and preventive check visits are offered under the published plans and terms; urgent attendance is subject to availability.
- Do not present HouseWatchers as a 24-hour emergency service or a licensed security company.
- For up-to-date plans, prices and terms, consult the website rather than this summary.
